run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-15T07:06:12Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend is firing because frontend's calls to the checkout service fail and those failures are recorded as ERROR spans on frontend. Frontend's STATUS_CODE_ERROR span rate rose from 0 to ~3.0/s between 07:06 and 07:16, and at 07:16:12 the errors are exclusively on the checkout path (client span grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 0.748/s and the matching POST, POST /api/checkout and 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' spans 0.748/s each, plus tcp.connect 0.022/s); every other frontend operation had an error rate of 0. The deepest cause the evidence supports is in the checkout workload: checkout's own oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder span rate held ~0.73-0.92/s until 07:04:12 and fell to 0 from 07:08:12, checkout recorded no ERROR spans at all, and the checkout Service has no ready endpoint (only notReadyAddresses 100.96.4.26:8080). The checkout pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q (ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb, deployment checkout) is not Ready: its checkout container is in CrashLoopBackOff with 11 restarts and a last termination reason Error, exit code 2 (started 07:12:00, finished 07:12:05). Its pod spec now runs gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest for both the checkout container and the wait-for-kafka init container, while its ReplicaSet/deployment template specifies ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout and busybox:latest; the pod carries annotations recording the original images ('checkout-normal': ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout, 'wait-for-kafka-init': busybox:latest) and it is the only pod in otel-demo with a pause image. Frontend-proxy also records its own errors ('router frontend egress' 0.756/s, 'ingress' 0.759/s at 07:16:12, against a ~0.004-0.02/s pre-07:06 baseline). The frontend pod itself is Ready with 0 restarts, and all other pods checked (including the eight co-located on node i-01375feffdca65277) are Ready with 0 restarts, so the failure is isolated to the checkout workload. Memory-limit OOM, node failure, Kafka failure and a frontend-internal fault were examined and are not supported by the evidence.

claims.text: Frontend's STATUS_CODE_ERROR span rate (sum over all span_name) went from 0 through 07:05:12 to 0.248/s at 07:06:12, 1.300/s at 07:08:12, 3.048/s at 07:12:12, peak 3.085/s at 07:13:12, 3.015/s at 07:16:12 and 0.952/s at 07:20:12, inside the authorized window.

At 07:16:12 frontend's error spans were entirely on the checkout path: grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 0.748/s, POST 0.748/s, POST /api/checkout 0.748/s, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout 0.748/s and tcp.connect 0.022/s; all other frontend operations (GET, GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, POST /api/cart, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, CartService/GetCart, CartService/AddItem, etc.) had STATUS_CODE_ERROR rate 0.

Checkout's own oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder span rate was steady at ~0.73-0.92/s until 07:04:12 (0.822/s), dropped to 0.426/s at 07:05:12, 0.644/s at 07:06:12, 0.278/s at 07:07:12 and was 0 from 07:08:12 through the last returned point at 07:17:12.

At 07:16:12 every checkout span rate by span_name was 0 and all carry STATUS_CODE_UNSET (HTTP POST, oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart, oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert, oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart, orders publish, oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder); no checkout span with STATUS_CODE_ERROR appears, so checkout was not processing requests rather than returning errors.

The checkout Service has no ready endpoints: its subset has addresses [] and notReadyAddresses ["100.96.4.26"] on port 8080, while its selector is opentelemetry.io/name=checkout and it targets port 8080.

Pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q: the checkout container is ready=false with 11 restarts, state waiting reason CrashLoopBackOff ("back-off 2m40s restarting failed container=checkout pod=checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q_otel-demo"), lastState terminated reason Error exitCode 2 startedAt 07:12:00Z finishedAt 07:12:05Z; the wait-for-kafka init container completed with exit 0 at 06:29:55Z; the pod Ready condition is False.

The checkout pod's live spec differs from its owner: the pod's checkout container image is gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest (containerPort 8080 named service, no command/args) and its wait-for-kafka init container image is also gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest, while pod annotations record checkout-normal=ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout and wait-for-kafka-init=busybox:latest.

ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb (owned by deployment checkout) template specifies container checkout image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout with no command/args and init container wait-for-kafka image busybox:latest with command sh -c "until nc -z -v -w30 kafka 9092; do echo waiting for kafka; sleep 2; done;"; its only template annotation is openshift.io/required-scc=restricted-v2.

Among all 21 pods in otel-demo, checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q is the only one whose container and init-container images are gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest; every other pod runs its ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-* image (plus busybox/busybox:latest init containers where present).

Deployment checkout reports spec.replicas 1, updatedReplicas 1, unavailableReplicas 1, readyReplicas null and Available=False with reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable (message "Deployment does not have minimum availability."), while its Progressing condition is NewReplicaSetAvailable=True.

The only events in otel-demo in the authorized window concern this pod: Pulled/Created container checkout and Started container checkout (count 7, lastTimestamp 07:08:00Z), Killing "Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted" (count 7, 07:08:05Z), Pulled "gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest" (count 6, 07:11:32Z) and Warning BackOff "Back-off restarting failed container checkout" (count 26, 07:12:53Z).

frontend-proxy records its own error spans on "router frontend egress" 0.756/s and "ingress" 0.759/s at 07:16:12; its total error span rate was ~0.004-0.022/s from 06:06:12 to 07:05:12 and then rose to 0.130/s at 07:06:12 and 1.544/s at 07:13:12 before declining to 0.491/s at 07:20:12.

The other 20 pods in otel-demo (including frontend-675fd7b5c5-gc9hg, kafka-ff7884766-svvv8 and every other co-located pod on node i-01375feffdca65277: cart, currency, email, frontend-proxy, load-generator, otel-collector, valkey-cart) are Ready with 0 restarts, and all five nodes report Ready=True.

All deployments except checkout are at revision 1 with their expected demo images; checkout's container memory limit is 512Mi and GOMEMLIMIT 16MiB, the same GOMEMLIMIT value as the healthy product-catalog deployment (product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc-q8nt8, Ready, 0 restarts).

A memory-limit OOM is not supported: the checkout container's last termination reason is Error with exit code 2 (not OOMKilled, and no Evicted event was returned), and the observed checkout container working set was ~12.2-13.4 MB against a 512Mi limit up to 06:59:12.

A node-level fault is not supported: eight other otel-demo pods on the same node i-01375feffdca65277 (cart, currency, email, frontend-proxy, kafka, load-generator, otel-collector, valkey-cart) are Ready with 0 restarts and the nodes are Ready, so only the checkout pod on that node is failing.

A frontend-internal fault is not supported: the frontend pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-gc9hg is Running and Ready with 0 restarts, and frontend's error spans are confined to its checkout calls (PlaceOrder plus the POST /api/checkout route spans) with 0 error rate on all its other operations.

Rejected: that GOMEMLIMIT=16MiB (Go soft memory limit) drove the checkout container into an out-of-memory exit. The container's last termination reason is Error with exit code 2 rather than OOMKilled, its observed working set stayed near 12.2-13.4 MB of a 512Mi limit, and product-catalog runs with the same GOMEMLIMIT=16MiB yet is Ready with 0 restarts.

Rejected: that a checkout dependency (Kafka or another downstream config) failing produced the outage. kafka-ff7884766-svvv8 is Ready with 0 restarts, the checkout wait-for-kafka init container completed with exit 0 at 06:29:55Z, and checkout was serving PlaceOrder at its normal ~0.8/s until 07:04:12, so its dependencies were adequate while the checkout application itself was still running.

Primary hypothesis (supported, deepest cause reached): the checkout pod's container definition was changed in place so that the checkout application image was replaced by gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest, which took the checkout workload out of service (no ready endpoint on checkout:8080, checkout span rate 0, CrashLoopBackOff); frontend's PlaceOrder calls to checkout then fail, frontend records those failures as its own ERROR spans and its error rate rises to the level the RequestErrorRate alert reports. The pod-spec/template image mismatch, the pause image pull event, the "Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted" kills, the empty ready address list and frontend's checkout-only error spans form the supporting chain.

Secondary hypothesis (unresolved): an external actor or tooling mutated the checkout pod rather than the deployment, because only the pod (not the ReplicaSet template) carries the pause images and the annotations checkout-normal and wait-for-kafka-init that record the original images. Who or what performed that mutation cannot be established from the available sources.

Restore the checkout workload by letting its controller recreate the pod with the template images (for example deleting checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q so ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb starts a pod with ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout and the busybox:latest wait-for-kafka init container), then verify the checkout Service has a ready address on 8080, oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder span rate returns to ~0.8/s and frontend's STATUS_CODE_ERROR rate returns to its pre-incident 0.

Do not treat this as an application bug in frontend or checkout: the pod-spec image overrides should be traced in cluster audit logs or in the fault-injection tooling that owns the checkout-normal and wait-for-kafka-init annotations, and a guard (admission policy or drift check between pod spec and ReplicaSet template) should prevent in-place pause-image substitution of running services.

gaps: No change-history integration is available in this Run (data_sources.not_integrated lists change_history), so what changed the checkout pod spec, by what actor and at exactly what time cannot be established; the pod-spec pause images and the recording annotations are observed, but the mutation event itself is not directly evidenced.

The crashing checkout container's output is unknown: fetch_pod_logs reported no previous instance for container checkout (HTTP 400 previous terminated container not found) and the current container stream ends at 06:51:14Z (view 1bee6e18-a267-45f1-b640-97c095683284-t0:c77d899f-903b-45bd-a43e-74830bc833fc was also marked incomplete by its line limit), so the message behind exit code 2 / reason Error at 07:12:05Z and the reason the pause-image container exits are unverified.

Jaeger returned no traces for service frontend in 07:00:00-07:24:27 (views b2b724f8-aebb-4296-afbc-caee508d7c11-t1:afde2d1a-1123-4a50-9859-7efcf6b1d18c, b2b724f8-aebb-4296-afbc-caee508d7c11-t2:5bd14aa5-a390-4adc-b4e7-fc4edf87f8b6, f63da7c1-a350-4c31-8edb-ef4c184d210a-t1:239410c4-9e1c-4a4e-a1b9-07482642366b and 8a485146-c8ac-460f-a6f7-a5510b7b1f4e-t1:6e0c4b59-8208-49b1-81ea-cc6f5d60f8f4 all returned no_data), so no span-level error text such as the gRPC status on grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder is available to confirm the exact failure mode during the incident.

Frontend pod logs were empty for 07:00:00-07:24:27 (view b26e4e04-24bb-4368-8eef-662059c96520-t0:3b02646e-e475-4845-9d25-6b6a093e9212, status no_data, 0 lines read), so the frontend's own application-log error text is unavailable as corroboration.

No alerting rules were returned by Prometheus (views b7918385-4d07-46dd-a62c-7ec8bab65ba1-t0:468d0f71-cd0c-4c5e-b4eb-9a75641a014c and 7beb746e-cfbc-44c7-9e42-e5f93bd27391-t0:a71f05a8-b281-4f92-ab67-51590d85e30c both returned no_data), so the alert's expression and threshold cannot be verified, and the annotation's 'current: 3.4999999999999996' could not be reproduced exactly (the observed frontend error span rate peaked at 3.085/s at 07:13:12).

Metric coverage is partial: services without a STATUS_CODE_ERROR series (cart, checkout, currency, email, image-provider, kafka, load-generator, product-catalog, quote, shipping) are unknown rather than proven error-free; only accounting, ad, fraud-detection, frontend, frontend-proxy, payment and recommendation had an ERROR series in the window.

Kubernetes-state metrics for the checkout pod were largely unavailable: kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total and kube_pod_container_info queries returned no_data (views 415da429-f0cf-475b-a139-8835b2f62a66-t1:f94f5894-d4f9-4550-8fa4-f5db23cabef1 and 916de183-a5e2-4c2c-89b6-e01e298d3add-t0:707037a8-8324-4db4-8cab-272959ed56a8), so restart history is known only from the pod's own status, and no OOMKilled or Evicted signal could be checked from kube-state metrics.

Whether the checkout deployment/pod was subsequently restarted by its controller or by a human during the incident window could not be resolved: the returned events were pod-level Pulled/Created/Started/Killing/BackOff entries only, and the pod name was not replaced.
next_steps: Inspect cluster audit logs or the fault-injection tooling that wrote the pod annotations checkout-normal and wait-for-kafka-init to identify who replaced the checkout container image with gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest and when.

Delete or force-recreate checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q (or otherwise restore the ReplicaSet template images) and confirm the checkout Service endpoint becomes ready, the PlaceOrder span rate returns to ~0.8/s and frontend error spans return to 0.
Add a guard or alert for pod-spec drift from the owning ReplicaSet container images so a pause-image substitution on a running service is detected immediately.

Reproduce the RequestErrorRate rule definition in Prometheus/Alertmanager source control to confirm its expression matches frontend STATUS_CODE_ERROR span rate and to make the annotation's current value traceable.

Among all 21 pods in otel-demo, checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q is the only one whose container and init-container images are gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest; every other pod runs its ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-* image (plus busybox/busybox:latest init containers where present).

Deployment checkout reports spec.replicas 1, updatedReplicas 1, unavailableReplicas 1, readyReplicas null and Available=False with reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable (message "Deployment does not have minimum availability."), while its Progressing condition is NewReplicaSetAvailable=True.

The only events in otel-demo in the authorized window concern this pod: Pulled/Created container checkout and Started container checkout (count 7, lastTimestamp 07:08:00Z), Killing "Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted" (count 7, 07:08:05Z), Pulled "gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest" (count 6, 07:11:32Z) and Warning BackOff "Back-off restarting failed container checkout" (count 26, 07:12:53Z).

frontend-proxy records its own error spans on "router frontend egress" 0.756/s and "ingress" 0.759/s at 07:16:12; its total error span rate was ~0.004-0.022/s from 06:06:12 to 07:05:12 and then rose to 0.130/s at 07:06:12 and 1.544/s at 07:13:12 before declining to 0.491/s at 07:20:12.

The other 20 pods in otel-demo (including frontend-675fd7b5c5-gc9hg, kafka-ff7884766-svvv8 and every other co-located pod on node i-01375feffdca65277: cart, currency, email, frontend-proxy, load-generator, otel-collector, valkey-cart) are Ready with 0 restarts, and all five nodes report Ready=True.

All deployments except checkout are at revision 1 with their expected demo images; checkout's container memory limit is 512Mi and GOMEMLIMIT 16MiB, the same GOMEMLIMIT value as the healthy product-catalog deployment (product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc-q8nt8, Ready, 0 restarts).

hypothesis.text: Primary hypothesis (supported, deepest cause reached): the checkout pod's container definition was changed in place so that the checkout application image was replaced by gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest, which took the checkout workload out of service (no ready endpoint on checkout:8080, checkout span rate 0, CrashLoopBackOff); frontend's PlaceOrder calls to checkout then fail, frontend records those failures as its own ERROR spans and its error rate rises to the level the RequestErrorRate alert reports. The pod-spec/template image mismatch, the pause image pull event, the "Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted" kills, the empty ready address list and frontend's checkout-only error spans form the supporting chain.

Secondary hypothesis (unresolved): an external actor or tooling mutated the checkout pod rather than the deployment, because only the pod (not the ReplicaSet template) carries the pause images and the annotations checkout-normal and wait-for-kafka-init that record the original images. Who or what performed that mutation cannot be established from the available sources.

recommendation.text: Restore the checkout workload by letting its controller recreate the pod with the template images (for example deleting checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q so ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb starts a pod with ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout and the busybox:latest wait-for-kafka init container), then verify the checkout Service has a ready address on 8080, oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder span rate returns to ~0.8/s and frontend's STATUS_CODE_ERROR rate returns to its pre-incident 0.

Do not treat this as an application bug in frontend or checkout: the pod-spec image overrides should be traced in cluster audit logs or in the fault-injection tooling that owns the checkout-normal and wait-for-kafka-init annotations, and a guard (admission policy or drift check between pod spec and ReplicaSet template) should prevent in-place pause-image substitution of running services.

counter_evidence.text: A memory-limit OOM is not supported: the checkout container's last termination reason is Error with exit code 2 (not OOMKilled, and no Evicted event was returned), and the observed checkout container working set was ~12.2-13.4 MB against a 512Mi limit up to 06:59:12.

A node-level fault is not supported: eight other otel-demo pods on the same node i-01375feffdca65277 (cart, currency, email, frontend-proxy, kafka, load-generator, otel-collector, valkey-cart) are Ready with 0 restarts and the nodes are Ready, so only the checkout pod on that node is failing.

A frontend-internal fault is not supported: the frontend pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-gc9hg is Running and Ready with 0 restarts, and frontend's error spans are confined to its checkout calls (PlaceOrder plus the POST /api/checkout route spans) with 0 error rate on all its other operations.

rejected_hypothesis.text: Rejected: that GOMEMLIMIT=16MiB (Go soft memory limit) drove the checkout container into an out-of-memory exit. The container's last termination reason is Error with exit code 2 rather than OOMKilled, its observed working set stayed near 12.2-13.4 MB of a 512Mi limit, and product-catalog runs with the same GOMEMLIMIT=16MiB yet is Ready with 0 restarts.

Rejected: that a checkout dependency (Kafka or another downstream config) failing produced the outage. kafka-ff7884766-svvv8 is Ready with 0 restarts, the checkout wait-for-kafka init container completed with exit 0 at 06:29:55Z, and checkout was serving PlaceOrder at its normal ~0.8/s until 07:04:12, so its dependencies were adequate while the checkout application itself was still running.
